assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness that are concerning for arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate these symptomatic events with potential cardiac dysrhythmias.
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The mitral valve insufficiency is coded as I34.0.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded as CPT 93229.
The service addresses the documented symptom of palpitations.
The symptom of palpitations is coded as R00.2.
The service addresses the documented symptom of dizziness.
The symptom of dizziness is coded as R42.
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the patient's concerning symptoms for underlying arrhythmia.
